quest.title: Ding Ding Dinggg! A Great Feast!
quest.description: The troubled days have come to an end. You and Paimon decide to pay Aino another visit...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

chapter.title: Ding Ding Dinggg! A Great Feast!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Ineffa! Oh, Jahoda! You're here, too?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Well, after all that hard work, I at least deserve a slice of cake for my efforts, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, there's cake!?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Yes. You two are here just in time.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Aino wanted to thank you for your help, so now that Krum-Clank is back safe and sound, she thought it would be nice for everyone to try out his baking.

dialogues.speaker: Krum-Clank 70% Sweet
dialogues.text: Clank... clank...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, so this is what Krum-Clank was supposed to look like!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Yes. Luckily, the core was still intact, so all Aino had to do was make a new body.

dialogues.speaker: Krum-Clank 70% Sweet
dialogues.text: Clank... clank...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, is it ready?

dialogues.speaker: Krum-Clank 70% Sweet
dialogues.text: Gulp...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, he ate it!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: It's not unusual for a chef to take a few bites before serving a dish.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: No need to worry. Once he's had his fill, he can get started on the desserts for everyone else. It'll just be a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright... Wait, speaking of desserts, where's Aino?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Ah, she thought of a new idea for a robot and shut herself in the workshop to get started. When inspiration strikes, she jumps into action. That's just who she is.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why does Aino like building robots so much?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Hm... Retrieving historical records from data bank...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: At first, I believe Aino was just shocked to find something that fascinated her more than desserts.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: And fortunately, her friends respected her passion — even if, aside from struggling to make ends meet, there was little time for much else.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Then, one day, an acclaimed teacher discovered her and recognized her passion for what it truly was... genius.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Just like her friends, she finally discovered what she wanted to do. And not only that, she excelled at it.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: And when genius and passion collide, there's not much that can get in the way.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: So, Aino left her childhood friends, established the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop, and started making all kinds of robot companions.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Perhaps it all comes down to the natural instinct of a genius... the drive to see their imagination come to life.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... So that's what draws her to robotics?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Based on my own experience with Aino, I think there's more to it than that.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Long before she took me in, she was already pushing her skills to the limit in an effort to give each robot a distinct personality, and she already treated them like companions.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: What I mean is, it's not something that started with me, just because I have a unique background.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I think, after walking the path of a genius for so long, she looked around and realized there was no one at her side, and it made her feel lonely.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: So, me, Krum-Clank, and all the other robots Aino has added to the workshop... We're not just proof of her genius.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: We're her family. We give her the companionship she longs for.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: As I see it, that's the true relationship between Aino and her robots.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, wow. So, you really mean a lot to her...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Yes. And for that reason, it did not matter to Aino how powerful Krum-Clank could become, nor how feared or coveted his technology might be among the factions.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: And she decided that he would join this family, and that meant she would spare no effort to save him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, that makes sense! But, it makes Paimon wonder why someone like Aino would choose to stay in Nod-Krai...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: ...I'm afraid my logic unit cannot make sense of that question.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, the way Paimon sees it, Nod-Krai is a dog-eat-dog place full of scheming and scamming. The people that thrive here seem to be built for that kind of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyone else would use the kind of tech Aino has to make weapons and threaten people.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Aino... she takes something that could be a weapon and turns it into a robot that makes cakes. It just doesn't seem like she fits in...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: No, my view is the exact opposite.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I've encountered the full spectrum of people that live here in Nod-Krai. But, in my experience, very few of them can be said to represent this place.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: You say Aino doesn't fit in here, but I believe the opposite. If I were to attempt to define what a person from Nod-Krai should be... no one is a better match than Aino.

dialogues.speaker: Krum-Clank 70% Sweet
dialogues.text: Ding... Ding...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Ooh, the desserts should be done!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Yes. One moment. Allow me to serve them.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I want the one with the most frosting!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Alright, everyone. Dig in.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Mmm! So worth it!
